voiceText: [calm] Indian passport holders in Singapore, this is for you. From 15 September 2026, Indian passports enter Thailand visa free for up to 30 days. Visa on arrival is gone for Indian travellers. The 30 days is for tourism only. For a longer stay, apply for the tourist e-visa through the Royal Thai Embassy in Singapore, and stay in Singapore until it is approved. Every visitor still fills in the free TDAC arrival card within three days before arrival, one for each entry. Check free at viza dot it dot com.
